summary: A review lane report carries an optional typed review block: an explicit ship or no_ship verdict and up to 64 findings with a closed P0-P3 severity and a closed low, medium, high confidence. The lane manifest declares the requirement per lane and the lane digest pins it; the adapter and the store both refuse a review completion without the block, live only, and stored completions replay unchanged through a worker.completed payload upcast. For the review lane the block discharges the severity obligation, so a free-text severity entry beside the block is refused. The lane verdict is report content only: it maps to no workflow field, and the coordinator records the workflow verdict through record_verdict. Extends CD-0056.
title: A review report carries a typed verdict and ranked findings
